extracted.name: Diabetics Lunch
extracted.description: Guess who just found out she’s diabetic? Girl likes to eat!!! So that being said, I will adapt and overcome. And I’m taking you all with me lol my friend Lee, this ones for you and the rest of Texas😂
ingredient_lines: portions Red wine vinegar and olive oil in equal amounts
as needed Salt, pepper, onion and garlic powder, sugar free sweetener
Good blop of stone ground mustard
instruction_lines: Put your lettuce on the plate. Drain the chicken and add to lettuce and eat the whole can of you want.
Slice or dice a big tomato and add to the plate.
Shake all your vinaigrette ingredients in a jar and pour on as much as you want. Coat everything. Have triscuits and cheese on the side.
This meal has 18 net carbs and a ton of protein. I’ve learned that carbs and proteins MUST be balanced.
